requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS product team building in-app search for a multi-tenant product catalog. Primary need: replace current BM25+LambdaMART pipeline with a neural reranker accessible via a reranking endpoint and batch offline scoring for nightly re-ranks. Targets: improvement in NDCG (>=+3%), latency P95 < 120ms for online rerank at 50 qps, offline scoring throughput 200k candidates/hour, cost sensitivity: ARR target 50k-150k. Must support SSO (SAML), audit logs, EU data residency for subset of customers, and ability to pin model versions and fallback to quantized variants for cost control.
